answer: Behavioral Entropy Scoring. Each agent identity accumulates a trail mixing response times, action sequences, and resource draw. After the fact, cluster detections flag identities whose trail shape correlates too tightly with known sybils, like a falcon spotting flock outliers. Every suspicious identity consumes an inlet of corroborating activity the attacker cannot fake cheaply: genuine varied interactions per identity. The detection threshold fines the whole cluster; the attacker pays forged diversity nectar, i.e., real compute and varied human-like behavior per identity,
